<execute>
from biomni.tool.biolip import parse_biolip_interactions, biolip_ligands
import pandas as pd

inter = parse_biolip_interactions(pdb_id="1GG1")
data = inter.get("data", {})
records = pd.DataFrame(data.get("records", []))
print("total records:", len(records), "| reported total:", data.get("total"))

summary = (records.groupby(["Ligand", "Chain", "Ligand_Chain"])
                 .agg(n_records=("Ligand", "size"),
                      site_ids=("Site_ID", lambda s: ",".join(sorted(set(s)))),
                      binding_residues=("Binding_Site_Residues_PDB", lambda s: sorted(set(s))[0]))
                 .reset_index())
print("\n--- BioLiP interaction summary for 1GG1 ---")
print(summary.to_string(index=False))

print("\n--- per-chain cross-check via biolip_ligands ---")
for ch in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
    r = biolip_ligands(pdb_id="1GG1", chain=ch)
    d = r.get("data", {})
    print(f"chain {ch}: ligands={d.get('ligands')} | chains={d.get('chains')} | interactions={d.get('total_interactions')}")
</execute>
